nodes.name: Validate Approval Callback
nodes.notes: Full update retained. Authorization is checked atomically against the stored job, never a username or message text.

parameters.query:
WITH decision AS (
  UPDATE yt_agent.jobs AS j
  SET status = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'a' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END,
      approved_hash = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'a' THEN j.manifest_hash ELSE NULL END,
      approval_token_hash = NULL,
      approved_by = $4::text,
      approved_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE $2::text IN ('a', 'r')
    AND j.status = 'awaiting_approval'
    AND j.approval_token_hash = encode(digest($1::text, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    AND j.approval_expires > now()
    AND j.telegram_chat_id = $3::text
    AND j.approver_ids @> jsonb_build_array($4::text)
    AND j.telegram_message_id = $5::text
    AND j.manifest IS NOT NULL
    AND j.manifest_hash = encode(digest(j.manifest::text, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    AND j.manifest->>'job_id' = j.id::text
    AND (j.manifest->>'revision')::integer = j.revision
    AND jsonb_typeof(j.manifest->'assets') = 'array'
    AND jsonb_array_length(j.manifest->'assets') > 0
  RETURNING j.id, j.revision, j.status, j.manifest, j.manifest_hash
), queued AS (
  INSERT INTO yt_agent.publications (asset_id, job_id, status)
  SELECT (asset->>'id')::uuid, d.id, 'pending'
  FROM decision d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.manifest->'assets') asset
  WHERE d.status = 'approved'
  ON CONFLICT (asset_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), audited AS (
  INSERT INTO yt_agent.audit (job_id, event, detail)
  SELECT d.id,
         CASE WHEN d.status = 'approved' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END,
         jsonb_build_object('actor_id', $4::text, 'chat_id', $3::text,
                           'message_id', $5::text, 'callback_query_id', $6::text,
                           'revision', d.revision, 'manifest_hash', d.manifest_hash)
  FROM decision d
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision) AS changed,
       COALESCE((SELECT id::text FROM decision), '') AS job_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT status FROM decision), 'unchanged') AS status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM queued) AS publications_queued,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM audited) AS audit_events,
       CASE
         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision WHERE status = 'approved')
           THEN 'Approved. The exact reviewed assets are queued for the publisher.'
         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision WHERE status = 'rejected')
           THEN 'Rejected. No assets from this review will be published.'
         ELSE 'No change: this button is handled, expired, unauthorized, or the review changed.'
       END AS answer_text;
